summary: AIOS Tech Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a 20-for-1 reverse share consolidation and increase in authorized share capital. The reverse split will combine each 20 shares into one, effective April 27, 2026, with no fractional shares issued; instead, shareholders will receive a whole share for any fractional interest. Authorized capital increases from $100M (480M Class A + 20M Class B shares, par $0.2) to $2B (9.6B Class A + 400M Class B shares, par $0.2). The consolidation aims to regain Nasdaq compliance under Rule 5550(a)(2). No advisor or recommendation is noted.
